draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 44th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 20 at S. He went 47th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Marcus Williams. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (13th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (0th percentile). College production: 53 tackles in 2023, 19th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 26 career games and 24 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Weak spots: passer rating allowed 132.2 (6th percentile), interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 safety who played: 72.7% season snap share against a median of 41.8%, above the norm.
